POSE / ANATOMY: Natalia sits comfortably UPRIGHT in the right third of the frame, torso and shoulders relaxed and nearly frontal. Head balanced directly over the torso, head vertical, chin neutral, eyes approximately level, normal short-to-average neck, both shoulders naturally connected and level. No head tilt, lateral neck bend, elongated neck or displaced jaw. No hand touching face. Her right hand correctly holds one dark green pen above an open cream notebook on the light oak desk; left hand rests naturally beside the notebook. Both hands, natural fingers, wrists and full notebook visible. Simple black blazer over a black top, discreet small necklace and watch. Medium-brown naturally wavy hair with believable individual strands; no exaggerated sculpted curls.

Keep the left 55% mostly quiet warm ivory plaster wall and a continuation of the light oak tabletop, with gentle broad sunlight and restrained window shadows suitable behind dark green HTML copy. The person is entirely to the right, face centred around 77% of frame width. Leave a generous uncluttered top margin above her head for the floating website header; complete hairline and head start around 20% of frame height. Put the pen and notebook around the lower 85% of the frame, with a little desk visible beneath. On the right: panoramic windows, softly visible garden greenery, a modest potted tree behind her and muted sage chair. Same pleasant daylight office character as Image 1. The room continues naturally to every image edge: no white side fade, no fog, no cutout silhouette.
PHOTOGRAPHIC QUALITY: crisp eyes, eyelashes, natural pores and expression lines, realistic cheek and neck shading, consistent neutral skin colour. Soft window daylight on face with controlled highlights, not bleached. Professional 50mm corporate editorial photograph at f/5.6, accurate human anatomy, natural fabric seams, believable pen grip and notebook pages. Retain honest mature facial detail. No beauty filter, waxy skin, painted or double facial edges, over-sharpened halos, patchy skin, fused hair/neck, duplicate fingers or artificial glow. The subject and props must withstand a close 100% inspection.
